defs.def: a collection of things, for example works of art, that are shown to the public （一批）展览品

ex.s: In the study, 187 people were invited to visit Kettle’s Yard gallery during an exhibition of handmade clay objects.
ex.t: 在这项研究中，187人受邀在手工陶艺品展览期间参观了Kettle's Yard美术馆。

ex.s: An exhibition at the Jiushi Art Museum in Shanghai is featuring artwork inspired by Go, or weiqi in Chinese, ____56____ originated in China more than 4,000 years ago.
ex.t: 上海久事美术馆的一场展览展出受围棋（中文称“围棋”）启发的艺术品，____56____（它）起源于4000多年前的中国。

ex.s: The movements of the black and white pieces reflect the basic ideas of Eastern philosophy, according to Tu Ningning, who is in charge of the exhibition.
ex.t: 与表现优于你的人比较，如果你关注的是他们拥有而你没有的东西，可能会产生嫉妒情绪；但如果你把这些比较作为激励的源泉，它也可以给你带来动力和启发，例如，"如果他们能做到，我也能。"与比你过得差的人比较，如果你想到自己也可能陷入类似的处境，可能会产生恐惧和担忧；但如果你用这种比较来拓宽视野，它可以激发感恩和欣赏之情——例如，"哇，情况本来可能更糟；我现在过得挺好的。"

ex.s: “The exhibition brings together Go culture, cutting-edge technology and contemporary art,” says Tu.
ex.t: 我希望早点教给女儿的就是这些细微之处。

ex.s: You try to lead the opponent into your trap and force them to follow your ‘____59____ (guide)’ till they lose,” explains Wang Wei, a Go player among the visitors to the exhibition.
ex.t: 你试图把对手引入你的陷阱，迫使他们跟随你的"____59____（引导）"，直到他们输掉，'参观展览的围棋棋手王伟解释说。

ex.s: Tu says that the balance between the black and white pieces, the beauty in the ____63____ (strategy) placement of the pieces, ____64____ the energy flow following each move inspired artists to create oil paintings, sculptures, ____65____ (digital) generated pictures and silk-screen prints for the exhibition.
ex.t: 涂说，黑白棋子之间的平衡、棋子____63____（战略性）摆放的美感，____64____每一步之后能量流动的气息，启发了艺术家为展览创作油画、雕塑、____65____（数字）生成的图画和丝网版画。

ex.s: We look forward to welcoming you as we showcase the creativity of the Harvard arts community through performances, art exhibitions and art-making activities.
ex.t: 我们期待你的到来，届时我们将通过演出、艺术展和艺术创作活动展示哈佛艺术社区的创造力。

ex.s: Try your hand at some of the painting tricks used by artists whose works will be in the upcoming exhibition of American Watercolors 1880-1990: Into the Light.
ex.t: 亲手尝试一些画家的绘画技巧，他们的作品将出现在即将举办的“美国水彩1880-1990：走进光明”展览中。

ex.s: It is an exhibition of oil paintings.
ex.t: 它是一个油画展。

ex.s: Still, I went to exhibitions often.
ex.t: 我还是经常去参观展览。

ex.s: This exhibition of some sixty masterpieces celebrating the life and work of Scotland’s best loved painter, Sir Henry Raeburn, comes to London.
ex.t: 这次展览展出约60幅杰作，庆祝苏格兰最受喜爱的画家Sir Henry Raeburn的生活和作品，来到伦敦。

ex.s: Selected from collections throughout the world, it is the first major exhibition of his work to be held in over forty years.
ex.t: 这些作品选自世界各地收藏，这是四十多年来首次举办他的作品大型展览。

ex.s: Last admission to the exhibition: 17.15.
ex.t: 最后入场时间：17:15。

ex.s: A new exhibition in Halifax uses everyday activities to explain the hidden math principles we all use on a regular basis.
ex.t: 打包行李、切蛋糕、猜测哪个果汁容器装的液体最多等等。

ex.s: Those viewing the quality of Abbot Hall’s temporary exhibitions may be forgiven for thinking they are in a city gallery.
ex.t: 那些欣赏Abbot Hall临时展览质量的人如果以为自己在城市画廊也是可以原谅的。

ex.s: The impressive permanent collection includes Turners and Romneys and the temporary exhibition programme has Canaletto and the artists from St Ives.
ex.t: 令人印象深刻的永久收藏包括Turner和Romney的作品，临时展览项目包括Canaletto和来自St Ives的艺术家作品。

ex.s: Exhibitions, events and family activities throughout the year.
ex.t: 全年都有展览、活动和家庭活动。
